shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs matches ---'; rg -n \"middleware|proxy|NextResponse\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/16-proxy.md; printf '\\n--- API headers ---\\n'; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; sed -n '370,420p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; printf '\\n--- runtime notes ---\\n'; rg -n \"runtime|Node.js|Edge|migration|middleware\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log(request.nextUrl.pathname)
+
+  const response = NextResponse.next()
+  response.headers.set('X-Request-Id', crypto.randomUUID())
+
+  return response
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short; git diff -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json; nl -ba proxy.ts'
